title: Demiurge historical 3-SAT claim: falsifiable, source-bound reproduction, competitiveness and independent learning
status_qualifier: Design proposed before independent holdout, not evidence of experiments or validation

historic_claim.raw_claim: Random 3-SAT instances with 220, 225, 230, 235 and 240 variables were solved on a consumer PC

hypotheses.label: Correctness and reproducibility
hypotheses.primary_endpoint: Verified SAT assignments or sound UNSAT proof accepted by pinned verifier; NOT identical randomized execution trace
hypotheses.claim_scope: Fixed disclosed implementations, instances and resources; historical recovery is a separate provenance gate

hypotheses.label: Competitiveness
hypotheses.primary_endpoint: Instance-paired PAR-2 using wall clock under fixed per-instance T; report solved count
hypotheses.claim_scope: Only within predeclared domain, mode and hardware

hypotheses.label: Improvement on never-exposed instances
hypotheses.primary_endpoint: Paired relative PAR-2 reduction of frozen post-training versus frozen pre-training over independent holdout formulas
hypotheses.claim_scope: Specified update target and training policy; no general self-improvement claim

instance_design.random_3cnf_definition: Exactly 3 distinct variable indices per clause, no repeated or complementary literal within a clause, polarity sampling specified before freeze; duplicate clauses policy must be pinned
instance_design.strata_interpretation: All stratum effects descriptive unless multiplicity-adjusted and predeclared
instance_design.phase_transition_caveat: Size and density grids target a historical claim; they do not imply universal computational complexity

complete_sat_unsat.accept_sat: Each reported assignment satisfies every clause of the original DIMACS bytes
complete_sat_unsat.accept_unsat: Pinned independent proof checker must accept pinned proof format; an unsolved stochastic search is NEVER UNSAT

resources.measurement_policy: Pinned process wall time, separate startup/load and solver time, peak RSS and CPU time; include all attempts and censored timeouts

metrics.primary_L2: PAR2 = arithmetic mean over formulas of actual wall seconds if solved within T, otherwise 2*T
metrics.statistical_unit: distinct CNF instance; seeds and training replicas are repeated measures, not independent CNFs
metrics.interval: cluster bootstrap by CNF, jointly preserving all paired solver runs and training-seed pairing; predefine random seed and repetitions before freeze
metrics.pass_rule: Lower bound of predeclared 95% confidence interval on relative improvement strictly exceeds 0.05, with correctness gate PASS
metrics.secondary_tests: Wilcoxon signed rank descriptive on per-instance paired data; not a replacement for censored PAR2 effect interval
metrics.multiplicity: Only L2 and L3 each have one family-wise primary comparator; other baselines and strata exploratory or predeclared adjusted using Holm
metrics.missing_and_timeout_policy: Timed out or crashed or missing result gets 2*T (unless integrity-invalid); never omit hard instances
metrics.reruns: No optional stop or selective rerun; retries count unless predeclared machine-fault criteria

training.change_type: UNDECLARED_MUST_FREEZE (weights vs heuristics vs ensemble routing)

blind_custody.reveal_policy: After all preregistered final result receipts are immutable; demonstrate hash match, provenance, and absence of earlier candidate access

requirements: Recover and hash actual historical solver + authentic CNF/seed evidence or narrow scope explicitly to modern reimplementation
Pin DIMACS generator and duplicate policy, solver versions, proof checker and all binary SHA-256
Freeze hardware/threads/memory/T, RNG protocol, attempts and resource accounting
Complete baseline and paired-cluster power analysis, adjust N if needed before freeze
Appoint independent custodian and separate access to private seeds, CNF and labels
Publish timestamped commitment hashes and candidate freeze receipt before scoring
Fix test inclusion/exclusion rules, analysis code SHA-256, multiplicity strategy and final verdicts
